tools.name: fibernet_catalog
tools.description: List operator-approved graphs and limits with no arguments ({}). Use the returned graph_id handles for validation, topology, electrical or prepare-only requests; file paths and uploads are not accepted. Summaries include source_sha256, node/edge counts and declared length_unit/frame_id. Units and frames are operator-asserted or unknown, not verified. Graph and artifact handles are session-local and expire at shutdown. Read tool results from structuredContent; errors set isError=true and include structuredContent.error.

tools.name: fibernet_validate
tools.description: Validate the native serialization and topology of a graph_id from fibernet_catalog. Read validation_status, counts and issues from structuredContent. An invalid graph can be a successful report with validation_status=invalid; request or worker failures instead set isError=true. This checks serialization_and_topology only, not geometric or mechanical validity, solver readiness, materials or units. No graph repair or physics solve is performed.

tools.name: fibernet_analyze_topology
tools.description: Analyze a graph_id from fibernet_catalog with the native topology API. structuredContent contains scalar counts and an artifact descriptor for the complete ID-aligned JSON metrics, preserving physical-edge identity. Counts and degrees are dimensionless; no geometry, materials or physics are inferred. Invalid graphs return a domain error with isError=true. Fetch full metrics using the returned artifact_id with fibernet_artifact_read; the artifact URI exposes only its manifest, not the full data.

tools.name: fibernet_artifact_info
tools.description: Get the stored manifest for an artifact_id returned by an analysis, electrical or preparation result in this session. structuredContent.artifact includes kind, byte_size, SHA256, source_sha256, producer and URI; it does not include artifact contents. Reading fibernet://artifacts/{artifact_id} also returns a manifest only. Use fibernet_artifact_read for data chunks. Handles and stored data expire at session shutdown; unknown or expired handles return an error with isError=true.

tools.name: fibernet_artifact_read
tools.description: Read an immutable artifact_id from this session using a byte offset (start at 0) and optional length of 1..32768 bytes (default 32768). structuredContent.data is base64 for that byte chunk, not JSON text; decode each chunk and concatenate bytes, advancing to next_offset until eof. Verify the complete bytes against total_bytes and sha256, which describes the whole artifact rather than each chunk. Offset past EOF or unknown handles return isError=true. Export needed data before shutdown: session artifacts are ephemeral.

tools.name: fibernet_solve_linear_transport
tools.description: Solve a bounded steady DC resistor graph using the native Python solver. Explicit S conductances and V boundary values use stable IDs; geometry unit comes from the graph catalog. Max 256 nodes, 1024 edges, 256 KiB request, 1 MiB result. Returns a paged native result artifact; no geometry/material inference, thermal or mechanical coupling. Uses fixed native conservation tolerances; MCP request cancellation reaps the worker.

tools.name: fibernet_prepare_deformed_transport
tools.description: Prepare a detached geometry/conductance/binding bundle using the native StructureGraph API and caller-prescribed xy translations in metres. Explicit m/mm/um graph unit must match the catalog. Exact safe-integer ID records, one row per node/physical edge. At most 1536 nodes, 2048 edges, 1 MiB request and 4 MiB result. Prepare only: no mechanics, electrical solve, inference or feedback. Read the single immutable artifact with existing chunk tools. Request cancellation before the commit checkpoint publishes nothing; committed artifacts are not rolled back.

tools.name: fibernet_solve_thermoelastic_network_snapshot
tools.description: Solve one experimental prescribed-temperature planar welded Euler-Bernoulli network snapshot using a session graph_id (2..192 nodes, 1..256 physical edges). Calls the existing Python owner once. Explicit length_unit m/mm/um must match the operator-asserted graph declaration; E_Pa is uniform and sections are solid circular from edge radii, not inferred material metadata. Complete stable-ID temperature_K and expansion_alpha_per_K records are required; constraints use nullable SI ux_m/uy_m/theta_rad, loads use Fx_N/Fy_N/Mz_Nm in the graph XY frame. Frame and units remain operator assertions, without frame transformation. No generation, heat solve, time history, feedback, regularization or stability certification. Full unmodified native snapshot is an ephemeral artifact; URI returns its manifest, bytes use fibernet_artifact_read. Errors use isError with structuredContent.error; out-of-profile geometry, supports or motion are refused by native.

tools.name: fibernet_project_fiber_network_report
tools.description: Construct the native checked endpoint-chord compatibility projection and return only its admission/loss report, never the FiberNetwork, mesh or physics result. Approved declared units/frame; no rescaling. Strict policies by default. Fixed ceilings: 256 nodes, 1024 edges, 4096 source points, 8192 output points, 16384 crosslinks, 1 MiB metadata/material and report. One synchronous bounded worker; MCP cancellation before publication terminates/reaps it. Read complete report through artifact chunks.
